description_en: Initiates a call when an agent is online
description_zh: 当座席在线时，通过此接口进行呼叫
name: CloudPreviewoutcall

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center. Before you call this operation, you must create a call center instance in the Cloud Call Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the agent. The value must be 3 to 10 digits in length
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The phone number of the customer to be called. Include the area code for landlines, and do not add 0 before mobile numbers. If the number hiding setting is enabled, you can obtain the value of customerNumberKey from the screen pop event to make an outbound call. If the number is encrypted, it must be URL-encoded before being passed. If the extension number support for outbound calls is enabled in the outbound call configurations, this field supports the mobile number-extension number format
parameters.help_zh: 需要进行呼叫的客户方电话号码，固话带区号，手机不加0。 当开启号码隐藏设置时，可从弹屏事件中获取customerNumberKey的值，进行外呼；如果是加密的号码，需要URLEncode后传入；当外呼相关配置-支持分机号外呼开启后，此字段可支持传手机号-分机号格式
parameters.name: tel

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for the agent side of the call. Valid values: 5 to 60. Default value: 30. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫座席侧超时时间；取值范围 5<=timeout<=60，默认30(单位:s)
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for the customer side of the call. Valid values: 5 to 60. Default value: 45. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫客户侧超时时间；取值范围 5<=dialTelTimeout<=60，默认45(单位:s)
parameters.name: dial_tel_timeout

parameters.help_en: The channel variables. Channel variables can be used in the following scenarios: 1. Event push: used as push fields. 2. Call records: stored in custom fields. 3. Downstream call links: passed to the downstream links of the call through SIP headers. Format: [{"name":"mainUniqueId","value":"cdr_main_unique_id","type":"2"},{"name":"callType","value":"cdr_call_type","type":"2"}]. name: the name of the variable. value: the value of the variable. type: the type of the variable. Valid values: 1 (common variable) and 2 (PJSIP_HEADER variable, which is used to pass the variable to the customer side through SIP headers. A maximum of 5 PJSIP_HEADER variables are supported)
parameters.help_zh: 通道变量可以在以下场景中使用：1. 事件推送，作为推送字段使用2. 通话记录中，将字段存储在自定义字段3. 通过SIP-Header方式将字段传到呼叫的下游链路格式如: [{"name":"mainUniqueId","value":"cdr_main_unique_id","type":"2"},{"name":"callType","value":"cdr_call_type","type":"2"}]name：变量名称value：变量值type：变量类型，1.普通变量 2.PJSIP_HEADER变量（用于将变量通过SIP-Header方式传到客户侧，最多支持5个）
parameters.name: call_variables

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the request. If no value is passed, the system generates one. If the number is encrypted, it must be URL-encoded before being passed
parameters.help_zh: 请求唯一id；取值：如果没有传入值则系统会生产。如果是加密的号码，需要URLEncode后传入
parameters.name: request_unique_id

parameters.help_en: The backup outbound call numbers. If the primary number cannot be reached, the system calls the backup numbers. A maximum of 5 numbers are supported. Separate multiple numbers with commas
parameters.help_zh: 备用外呼号码；tel没呼通时呼叫备用号码，最多支持5个号码，多个之间用逗号分隔
parameters.name: backup_tels

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to conduct a satisfaction survey. Valid values: 0 (do not conduct a satisfaction survey) and 1 (conduct a satisfaction survey). Default value: the enterprise configuration
parameters.help_zh: 是否满意度调查；0.不进行满意度调查 1.进行满意度调查，默认：取企业配置
parameters.name: is_investigation

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) transcription for the call recording. Valid values: 0 (do not perform transcription) and 1 (perform transcription). Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 此次通话录音是否进行ASR转写；0.不进行 1.进行 默认：1
parameters.name: cdr_is_asr

parameters.help_en: The enterprise trunk number or the configured customer-side outbound caller ID number
parameters.help_zh: 可传入企业中继号码或设置好的客户侧外显号码
parameters.name: ob_clid

parameters.help_en: The specified area code for the outbound caller ID. If an area code is passed, the caller ID is displayed under the specified area code. If both ObClid and ObClidAreaCode are passed, the ObClid value is used as the caller ID
parameters.help_zh: 指定外显区号；传入区号，在指定区号下外显号码；如果obClid和obClidAreaCode都传的情况下，按照obClid外显
parameters.name: ob_clid_area_code

parameters.help_en: The customer-side caller ID number group. To use ClidGroup, the account must support identifier-based routing. When this parameter is used, the Clid parameter is invalid
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧外显号码组；使用clidGroup需要账号支持按标识路由，使用此参数时clid参数无效
parameters.name: ob_clid_group

parameters.help_en: The collection of caller ID numbers. Format: [{"clid":"1708587xxxx","priority":1},{"clid":"1304412xxxx","priority":2},{"clid":"0107990xxxx","priority":3}]. clid: the caller ID number (String type, required). priority: the priority (Integer type, optional). Note: A maximum of 10 specified numbers can be passed for a single call. If the number priority is specified, the priority must be passed for all numbers
parameters.help_zh: 外显号码集合, 格式如: [{"clid":"1708587xxxx","priority":1},{"clid":"1304412xxxx","priority":2},{"clid":"0107990xxxx","priority":3}] clid：外显号码（String类型）（必填）priority：优先级（Integer类型）（非必填） 特别说明： 一次呼叫最多允许传10个指定号码；若指定了号码优先级，要求所有传入的号码都必传
parameters.name: clid_list

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

Code.description_en:
The status code of the request.
A return value of OK indicates that the request is successful.
For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
